senses.gloss: Yuvanāśva, an ancient king. § 6 (Anukramanikāp.): I, 1, 226 (in Sañjaya's enumeration).--§ 407 (Māndhātrup.): III, 126, 10427 (Ikshvākuvaṃśaprabhavaḥ), 10441, 10451 (Y. bore Māndhātṛ, who came out piercing his left side).-§ 475 (Dhundhumārop.): III, 202, 13517 (king of Ayodhyā, son of Adri and father of Śrāva).--§ 595 (Shoḍaśarāj., v. Māndhātṛ): VII, 62, 2274 (ºsya jaṭhare, birth of Māndhātṛ, cf. § 407).--§ 632b (Shoḍaśarāj., cf. § 595): XII, 29, 975 (do., do.).--§ 655 (Āpaddh.): XII, 159, 5924 (acquired heaven).--§ 656 (Khaḍgotpattik.): XII, 166, 6197 (received the sword from Raivata, from him it passed over to Raghu).--§ 677 (Mokshadh.): XII, 235, 8599 (attained to heaven by way of gifts, PCR. connects Y. with Vṛshādarbhi, but probably wrongly; cf. XIII, 6254).--§ 761 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 115, 5663 (abstained from meat during the month of Kārttika). Cf. Saudyumni.
Yuvarājā Cedīnāṃ (“the crown prince of the Cedis”): VII, 9330 (cf. 9336, †9337, †9342, 9343 (slain by Aśvatthāman), 9400).
